title: lobelia triquetra var. microdon
intro: Lobelia triquetra var. microdon, commonly known as Lobelia, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lobelia include its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as expectorant, bronchodilator, and spasmolytic properties.
